elements.originalText: Definitions

elements.text: recordset: a set of records of one model, e.g. shelter.animal(1,2,3). Can be empty.
elements.originalText: recordset: a set of records of one model, e.g. shelter.animal(1,2,3). Can be empty.

elements.text: @api.model: method called on the model, not on specific records.
elements.originalText: @api.model: method called on the model, not on specific records.

elements.text: domain: list of conditions for search, e.g. [('adopted','=',False)].
elements.originalText: domain: list of conditions for search, e.g. [('adopted','=',False)].

elements.text: website.published.mixin: adds is_published and website_url to a model.
elements.originalText: website.published.mixin: adds is_published and website_url to a model.

elements.text: controller / route: Python method answering a URL (@http.route).
elements.originalText: controller / route: Python method answering a URL (@http.route).

elements.text: auth='public': anybody can open it, even without login.
elements.originalText: auth='public': anybody can open it, even without login.

elements.text: website=True: gives the route the website context (layout, menu, language).
elements.originalText: website=True: gives the route the website context (layout, menu, language).

elements.text: QWeb: Odoo template language (t-foreach, t-if, t-out, t-call).
elements.originalText: QWeb: Odoo template language (t-foreach, t-if, t-out, t-call).

elements.text: t-call: insert another template at this place.
elements.originalText: t-call: insert another template at this place.

elements.text: model converter: <model('x'):rec> in a URL turns the id into the record, 404 if missing.
elements.originalText: model converter: <model('x'):rec> in a URL turns the id into the record, 404 if missing.

elements.text: CSRF token: secret value in a form that proves the post comes from our own page.
elements.originalText: CSRF token: secret value in a form that proves the post comes from our own page.

elements.text: sudo(): runs with superuser rights, ignoring access rights. Use only after checks.
elements.originalText: sudo(): runs with superuser rights, ignoring access rights. Use only after checks.

elements.text: whitelist: copy only the allowed fields from user input.
elements.originalText: whitelist: copy only the allowed fields from user input.

elements.text: UserError: error shown to the user as a message.
elements.originalText: UserError: error shown to the user as a message.

elements.text: web.assets_frontend: bundle of JS/CSS loaded on every public website page.
elements.originalText: web.assets_frontend: bundle of JS/CSS loaded on every public website page.

elements.text: website.menu: an entry of the website navbar.
elements.originalText: website.menu: an entry of the website navbar.
